item.title: New Mexico Senate Bill 241 sparks push back from early childhood educators
item.description: This week two bills were passed in the Senate, intended to strengthen the state's universal child care program, But early childhood educators are pushing back saying that one of the bills fails to include fair wages and the needed protections to support the work force.
